content: Soldaariŋ Kiristaani
Ini kaɗ nga ɗa kuɓkiŋ ngo Timoote, ɓaatka hatil ŋ baahohi Kooh baahoh ɗa, ŋ niki fu nik ŋ Kiristaani Yeesu.
Ini fu kerah ho jangɗoheeɗa ŋ fiki seede laayiɗ, dengkohaa ɓi ɓo' oolkuuɗ, ɓi namana min jangiɗ ɓi ɓo' wiiriis.
Teyɗuka ɓakiŋ ɗa ŋ miskiɗi findi soldaar baahiɗ ŋ soldaar ciŋ Kiristaani Yeesu.
Soldaar waaɗ ne yi adgoh ɗe neɓu nga ɗe ɗah, a taambkohanɗi in ciŋ kipes ki.
Te leberoh waaɗ saah ɗah, a hey taambe in ci leber nakoh.
Panguk guuroh miskiɗ lool, tahha po a yi joy koc rahas ɓakiŋ ɗe ŋ ruundiɗ ci.
Liiɓa baahiɗ ŋ ini ŋ woo ɗa, Heɗi hey ɗa one fu min inah in ci ŋ woo ceem jen.
Naandsuka Yeesu Kiristaa yi hulit
Liiɓa ŋ Yeesu Kiristaa, findi ŋ yegɗohee ɗu wa wi ŋ woyee ɗu Yegɗohiŋ Muci. A puloh ŋ cuuɓiŋ Dawuuda, a kaaniɗ, a hultiɗuusa.
Yegɗoheem weɗ tah ho raak miskiɗ po ŋ ceenu haa tumoh moɗaaɗi. Waaye woo kiŋ Kooh ceenuuɗi.
Weɗ tah ho muñee miskiɗ ci jen sagu ɓooɓi Kooh kooɗ ne ɓa min rahas muci ŋ niki ɓa nik ŋ Kiristaani Yeesu ; ɓa nam yakɗu po faw.
Woo kii wooriɗ :

content.text: Ɓoo faɗ ini ɓoo woo ɗah,
a risan tum ini a woo,
laam a minɗi taas haf ce.

content: In ceem ceɗ fu joy naandsoh. Ŋ fiki Kooh, woya ɓi na taastiɗohe ŋ ini kaɗ ŋ toksiŋ woo ci, ɓa faɗ ineem. Wa raakɗi njiriñ, ɗal yahroh ɓi na sikɗuke.
Pangkohi neɓ Kooh
Ndengɗuka po fu neɓ Kooh findi pangkoh baahiɗ, yi na supkeeɗi ŋ ini a na haɓɗe, yi na jangɗohe hooliɗ woo kiŋ keeh ki.
Kina ɓaah ŋ woo mbalay, ci hunɗi na kos. Ɓi na tume ineem uupan uup us Kooh.
Woo ciŋ ɓa mandan na puusi minɗi faɗ wi na ɓaatke ɓaatuk kaɗe. Himene na Fileet ɓaah ŋ ɓooɓeem.
Ɓa usiɗ keeh ki ŋ ini ɓa na woye ne kosiɗ ci hultiɗ po ƴutiɗ ; ŋ ineem ɓa ɗii yahroh kosiŋ ɓum.

Waaye ɓooɓi Kooh tufkiɗ, kosiŋ ɓa ndengiɗ tir findi atoh ci raan taɓah. Woo kii fiisuusa nga ca : « Heɗi inhiɗ ɓi a raak. » Na woo kii : « Ɓo' nu woo ne a ɓaah ŋ Heɗi ɗah, a wortukaat in nu nik in baahaaɗi ɗah ! »
Ŋ ɗooƴ kahan yakiɗ, e pangkoha haɓɗohuuɗ urus na haalis dong nik nga haa, wa namiɗ raak pangkoha haɓɗohuuɗ ndooɗ na ɗok. Cum njirñiɗkoha ŋ ceeke, cum njirñiɗkoha ŋ in ci ƴin ƴin ci.
Ɓo' nu hooliɗ haf ce ŋ in ci baahaaɗiici ɗah, a mandan na pangkohaani hoolɗu wuu Kooh, wi eɗu cir. A hey raakɗe heɗ ce njiriñ, te a hey mine panguk panguk baahiɗ nu nik.
Nupa waaɗ-waaɗ ci baahaaɗiici kikomaaki na waaɗɗukohee ɗa. Ndengɗuka po fu nik ɓo' yurhiɗ, fu min oolku, fu waaɗ ɓooɓi, fu raak jam na ɓa. Pesoha ɗaa na ɓi na kiime Heɗi na keeñ hooliɗ.
Sanga taastiɗoh ci naandohaaci, dofohaaci, fu inhiɗ ne ca na ɓeke lahtoh.
Te ñaamiŋ Heɗi joyɗi lahtoh. A joy joy baah ŋ ɓooɓi jen, a min jangɗoh, a min muñɗoh ;
a kuƴsee ɓi na taasee ɗe na yeeɓuk, ya ɓa inah andi Kooh onanɗi ɓa ɓa ɓoƴsoh pesohaaɗ po ɓa inah keeh ki.
Ŋ ineem ɓa hey dokke ŋ sagoociŋ ɓa, ɓa fus ŋ fiir ciŋ Seytaani yi ambee ɓa ñaam te a tumɗukoheeɗa ɓa waaɗ-waaɗiŋ ɗe.
